passages.text: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
passages.note: Loneliness and the need for companionship

passages.text: By the sweat of your face will you eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For you are dust, and to dust you shall return.”

Yahweh said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen? If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
passages.note: Anger and resentment; mastering the impulse to do wrong
